about: Neutral filler sentences for the long-source edge cases. A long source is built by cycling these sentences to the requested word count, with the case's needle sentence placed at the requested position. None of these sentences shares a content word with any needle.
sentences: The town market sets up its stalls along the river path on most mornings.
Fishmongers arrive before sunrise and pack their crates with crushed ice.
A narrow lane behind the bakery leads up to the old chapel on the hill.
Local cyclists often stop at the fountain to refill their water bottles.
The weather along the coast changes quickly when wind comes off the sea.
Gardeners in the valley grow beans, onions and squash in tidy garden beds.
The village school keeps a small orchard of apple and pear trees.
Most shops close for an hour around midday and open again in the afternoon.
Hikers usually follow the ridge trail because it offers wide views of the bay.
The lighthouse keeper's cottage now houses a modest maritime museum.
Farmers bring cheese, honey and fresh eggs to the square every weekend.
Narrow wooden boats are painted in bright colours and moored in the harbour.
The regional bus stops twice an hour outside the post office.
Children gather in the park after lessons to play football on the grass.
An annual music evening fills the courtyard with folk songs and dancing.
The stone walls around the fields were built by hand generations ago.
Sheep graze on the slopes above the village throughout the warmer part of the year.
Visitors often photograph the arched footbridge that crosses the stream.
The town hall clock was restored by volunteers and chimes every hour.
A small cinema shows classic films on rainy evenings in the winter season.
Fog settles over the marshes early in the day and lifts by mid-morning.
The pottery studio sells bowls and jugs glazed in deep blue and green.
Several families run guesthouses with views over the rooftops to the water.
The cobbled main street is closed to cars during the summer fair.
Birdwatchers come in autumn to see geese resting on the tidal flats.
